acceptance_authority: stage1_freeze.json; current acceptance is not inferred from historical component counts

authorized_delivery.ordinary_private: admit modeled invited-delivery terminal access when all other checks pass
authorized_delivery.private_nodes: ordinary private access nodes may be traversed only for the modeled invited delivery; preserve source tags and purpose restrictions
authorized_delivery.purpose_only_roads: private, destination/customers and service roads are terminal-only; never public through-routing
authorized_delivery.source_tag_absence: absence of a prohibition is a modeling default, not observed unrestricted real access

all_roles: other Microsoft buildings not intersecting the source location geometry

customer_geometry: unchanged full independent-residence footprint or source-supported residential-complex extent; nearest geometry pair, never centroid substitution
depot_geometry: unchanged internal representative point; native OSM extent retained only to scale local candidate search; spatial_depot_v2 group identities unchanged

distance.connector_length: source geometry to selected local physical-road projection only
distance.terminal_length: additional real directed OSM road distance, stored separately from geometric connector

local_candidate_check.alternative_permissions: strict motor access only; no private authorization used to rescue a failed nearest frontage
local_candidate_check.checks: real directed entry and exit plus the same exclusion, mapped-water, road-crossing and customer-building obstacles
local_candidate_check.hard_failures: no alternate search bypasses explicit prohibition, sensitive exclusions, unsupported barriers or mapped water
local_candidate_check.initial_candidate: nearest physical road, including diagnostic restricted candidates
local_candidate_check.no_valid_candidate: retain original source location and nullable units; mark pending and exclude from default activation pool
local_candidate_check.radius_with_source_extent: initial geometry gap + 2 * source extent bounding-box diagonal

local_inventory: available valid complete ways in the frozen regional PBFs intersecting city + 20km; provider extract coverage bounds the effective domain
model_target: source-supported potential delivery locations and directed access in a city road environment
operational_unit_estimates: nullable; unresolved source-owner scope clears the modeled estimate under source_scope_identity_guard_v1
public_export: exclude private build masks, excluded-sensitive source inventories and internal blocked-road inventories

road_selection.coverage_claim: relative to this finite frozen OSM envelope; no guarantee of complete global routing connectivity
road_selection.outside_city_roads: routing/access only; source locations remain within frozen service boundary
road_selection.selection: smallest junction-node buffer recovering all city public nodes reachable at the maximum available envelope

scope: customer/depot location components; common charging/speed rebinding, CLE structure/construction and instance activation remain separate audited steps
sensitive_hosts: public_location_exclusions_v1 source/anchor policy; source-safe uncertain access retained without publishing excluded anchors

terminal_paths.connection: shared OSM nodes; never proximity-only fabricated junctions
terminal_paths.direction: source one-way, reverse and roundabout direction; turn-restriction relations not yet modeled
terminal_paths.entry_and_exit: separate real directed source-edge paths ending at public reference-SCC gateways
terminal_paths.gateway_choice: independently shortest directed ingress/egress to the public reference SCC; not a proof of globally optimal OD choice over all entrances
terminal_paths.legacy_matrix_consumer: reject terminal rows rather than silently omit access paths
terminal_paths.metric_claim: do not assume symmetry or triangle inequality for a purpose-specific directed terminal OD construction
terminal_paths.operating_speed: not inferred by location admission; explicit smoke-test speeds do not constitute a production speed layer
terminal_paths.pair_scope: only source egress and destination ingress are materialized, with source ownership and authorization metadata

verification_required: actual 11-city saved source ownership, source/graph/policy/code hashes, independent SCC, directed paths, common source-edge speeds and cost conservation; authority is the final cohort certificate
